items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez spent 8 months in a Mexican jail and was out of high-level training during that period.
items.quote: Daniel Rodriguez is coming back into this fight after spending 8 months in jail in Mexico. He was caught at the US Mexico border with some weed and he spent eight months in Mexico jail for that.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez lost 15 pounds of muscle and barely trained while in jail.
items.quote: he lost 15 lbs of muscle. Barely trained at all. Only two times a week he was allowed to go to the yard, so he had some space to do laps. This is all in his own words.

items.claim: Uros Medic has a speed advantage in his hands, movement, decision-making, and reaction time compared to Daniel Rodriguez.
items.quote: Uros Medic is way faster than him just in general. Like, he lands faster. He has a speed advantage in his hands for sure... Not only does he have a speed advantage with his hands, he has a speed advantage with his movement, with his decision making, with his vision.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez has shown good recoverability throughout most of his career, notably coming back to win against Kevin Holland.
items.quote: He's shown good recoverability throughout most of his career, honestly. Notably, in that Kevin Holland fight recently, he was completely done in that fight. He was finished in that fight and he was able to come back.

items.claim: Uros Medic is a first-round knockout artist who hits very hard.
items.quote: Uros Medic hits really hard, who is a first round knockout artist at the end of the day, who just knocked out Jeff Nil, who pretty durable himself.
